note: Declared registry of what the swarm exposes to callers. `open` is declared here, not probed. `refine` now enforces payment in code (swarm_core.x402 guards apps/refinery POST /query), but the refinery listens on the box only — so the row stays honestly closed until the endpoint is actually reachable. `price` is not stored here: it is joined in from swarm_core.tokens.PRICE_SHEET at serve time, so the feed cannot advertise a price the middleware does not charge.
